data: Mohammed bin Rashid Space Centre / University of Colorado LASP
First Arab interplanetary mission; first holistic global view of the Martian atmosphere through a Mars year
Added for PRD-023 Slice A — active Mars orbiter rendered as 3D glyph on /explore. Memory feedback_global_space_program_representation — UAE explicit, not silently dropped.

The UAE's Hope orbiter — Emirates Mars Mission, known in Arabic as Al-Amal. Reached Mars in 2021 and provided the first holistic global view of the Martian atmosphere through a complete Martian year. Built in partnership with the University of Colorado LASP.
First detailed imaging of the Sun's polar regions
First Chinese Mars mission; delivered Zhurong
First mission to the Jupiter Trojans
Twin-orbiter joint ESA + JAXA Mercury mission — splits into MPO + Mio at Mercury arrival in 2026
Closest spacecraft to the Sun ever flown
